## Summary

What feature are you requesting? (1–2 sentences)

## Motivation

Why is this needed? Describe the use case — e.g. missing L3 message type blocking a BTS procedure, lack of builder for a domain, or performance bottleneck.

## Proposed Solution

How should it be implemented? Include:

- Target spec section (GSM 04.08, TS 24.008, etc.)
- Affected module (parser, builder, LAPDm, stack/procedures, RSL)
- Sketch of the new API surface if applicable

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you evaluated.

## Additional Context

References to existing implementations (osmo-bts, srsRAN), pcap captures, or test vectors.
